name: hardware-button
reason: Deliberate third delivery path, recorded in `crates/amos-tauri/src/buttons.rs` and `docs/hardware-buttons.md`: the shell consumes a press through (a) the pull command `take_pending_hardware_button` (the reliable on-device path, polled by `svelte/osInputBridge.startOsHardwarePoll`) and (b) a DOM `CustomEvent("hardware-button")` that `buttons::dispatch_dom` evaluates into every webview (caught by `startOsInputBridge`). The Tauri `emit` stays as the desktop/plugin path for a host that *does* deliver `plugin:event|listen`; no Svelte screen subscribes to it, and adding a third handler would double-fire navigation. Removing the emit is a device-behaviour change that cannot be verified here (Round 48).

name: dock-badge-changed
reason: Emitted by `crates/amos-tauri/src/dock_badge.rs`, which is **compiled and registered** since REQ-A389 (it used to be outside the module tree), so this emit is live: applying a badge now reaches the frontend bus. No Svelte screen subscribes yet — the Dock tile does not paint the badge the host offers (same state as the two `dock_badge_*` commands in `tauri-command-allowlist.json`). The entry stays so the gate records a deliberate no-subscriber, and it is reported as stale the moment a screen subscribes.

name: biometric-result
reason: Deliberate mirror with no consumer (REQ-A412). The biometric result reaches the UI through the **command**: `biometric_authenticate` awaits the `oneshot` the JNI callback fills (`jni_glue::Java_..._BiometricGlue_onBiometricResult` sets the state and fires the sender), and `src/lib/biometric.ts` resolves with it. The `emit("biometric-result", …)` in the same callback exists for a screen that renders results without owning the call (a notification, a lock-screen affordance); that screen does not exist yet — `src/lib/biometric.ts` itself is allow-listed as an unwired library surface in `crates/amos-tauri/frontend-ts/scripts/unwired-allowlist.json`. Recorded here so the gate says "deliberate mirror", not "the host is shouting into the void".
